Operator field corrected from blank to Lincoln Rackhouse based on the facility own name (source data left operator blank). Reused operator-level research from twoai_dc_operators row: Lincoln Rackhouse.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Lincoln Rackhouse is the data center real estate division of Lincoln Property Company, a major diversified real estate services firm headquartered at 2000 McKinney in Dallas, Texas, with more than 4,000 professionals across over 100 markets in the United States and Europe. The division formed in September 2010 when Lincoln Property acquired Dallas-based Rackhouse Group, a data center tenant representation firm founded in 2006 by former Trammell Crow Company executives Martin Peck, Peter Tippen, and Brant Bernet. Following the acquisition, the combined Lincoln Rackhouse business expanded beyond tenant representation into data center development and construction services, with Lincolns chief operating officer at the time describing data centers as a dynamic but underserved real estate segment. Lincoln Rackhouse operates a data center in Silver Spring, Maryland, per third-party directory listings, and has partnered with Ascent, another operator already profiled in this registry and now a subsidiary of WESCO International, to expand its data center facilities management platform. Trade press has separately reported a Maryland data center sale to a local real estate group, though this registry could not independently confirm whether that transaction involved the specific facility recorded here under Lincoln Rackhouse. As a real estate services companys data center division rather than a pure-play operator, Lincoln Rackhouses business model combines property ownership, tenant representation, and third-party facilities management in a way distinct from the wholesale developers and colocation REITs elsewhere in this registry. This specific facility, recorded in this registry as Lincoln Rackhouse in DuPage County, IL, was not individually named in the operator-level research above; its operator field was blank in the source data and is corrected here to Lincoln Rackhouse based on the facility own name, which unambiguously identifies its operator brand. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
